name: hellohop
description: Read and send WhatsApp messages from your agent through HelloHop, an independent WhatsApp API. Sending is off by default.

api_token.title: HelloHop channel token
api_token.description: Your channel token from the HelloHop console. Get a free sandbox token at hellohop.app.

channel_id.title: HelloHop channel ID
channel_id.description: The channel ID shown next to your token in the HelloHop console.
